cells.gaps: No source found names two separate health systems exchanging data: the DHIS2 Tracker being rolled out from 2026 is part of DHIS2, not a second system.
cells.note: The DHIS2 Tracker feeds patient-level data into the national DHIS2 (GAB-001); modules inside DHIS2 are not two systems exchanging, so the row sets no rung. No other row is held.
